title: Cross-line attention: MT-LM vs vanilla AR
claim: MT-LM exhibits cross-line attention over previous, current, and later lines. Its previous/current per-token pattern matches a vanilla AR baseline; the distinguishing feature is a nonzero later-line component (structurally absent in AR, exactly 0), concentrated in a minority of heads. We report attention allocation, not a causal/functional effect.
metric: per-token lift = content-attention-share / token-share (1 = proportional to availability; anchors/<sot>/<bos> excluded). Median over heads, mean over docs. Never averaged across heads as a single number.

representative_head.note: strong cross-line head used for the line x line figure

takeaway: previous and current lifts are similar across MT and AR; later is the difference: MT > 0 (here, minority of heads, up to 4.8x), vanilla = 0 by construction.
